Has successfully completed the Advanced Certificate in Infection Prevention Practices,
demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of infection control protocols, sanitization
procedures, and evidence-based hygiene practices for healthcare and commercial settings.

This certificate is awarded by the Institute of Infection Control, an
accredited training body recognized by: Royal Society for Public Health
(RSPH), Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Certification Service, International Federation of Infection Control (IFIC)

Topics covered: Microbiology and Pathogen Transmission, Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs)
Prevention, Standard and Transmission-Based Precautions, Environmental Cleaning and Disinfection,
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Protocols, Sterilization Techniques and Quality Assurance,
Outbreak Management and Response, Regulatory Compliance (CDC, WHO, CQC Guidelines)
